name: ActiveDirectoryBuild
description: Builds the first Domain Controller and establishes a new Active Directory forest from scratch, including AD DS/DNS/BitLocker/RSAT features, forest creation, strict password/lockout policies, replication sites, KDS Root Key, AD groups/OUs/users/gMSAs/CNOs, DNS zones, and three admin user accounts.

name: ActiveDirectoryHub
description: Promotes an additional Domain Controller as a replica and joins it to an existing forest, applying base OS hardening, installing AD DS/DNS/BitLocker/RSAT features, and monitoring the NTDS service.

name: AzureConnect
description: Generic domain-join baseline for Azure-hosted Windows nodes, applying base OS hardening (UAC, timezone, execution policy), installing BitLocker, and joining the machine to Active Directory.

name: MemberServer
description: Domain-join baseline for generic Windows member servers, applying base OS hardening, installing BitLocker, and joining the domain via xDSCDomainjoin.

name: MemberServerSQL
description: Provisions a SQL Server 2016 member server with a named instance, gMSA-based service accounts, custom TCP port configuration, and an inbound firewall rule for SQL connectivity.

name: RedForestBuild
description: Configures the Host Guardian Service (HGS) Red Forest — an isolated AD forest for the Guarded Fabric — installing HGS roles, enforcing strict password/lockout policies, creating HGS-specific AD groups and replication sites, and configuring DNS forwarders.

name: S2DHypervisorDell
description: Configures a Dell server as a Storage Spaces Direct (S2D) Hyper-V cluster node, installing Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, Guarded Fabric, and related features, and creating an external virtual switch with dual-NIC SET teaming.

name: StandAloneHypervisorDell
description: Configures a Dell server as a standalone (non-clustered) Hyper-V host with the full Guarded Fabric feature set and an external virtual switch using a single NIC.
